propositions: Eight empty, uncommitted, unreferenced top-level directories exist in the tracker with no CREATE events and mtimes >30 minutes old, flagged as debris of interrupted writes.

rebar tracker-maintenance --clean uses all-or-nothing deletion: it deletes every directory in the foreign_store_path_list with no per-directory filtering, so the run-level gate must assert the foreign list equals exactly the 8 triaged ids before executing.
All five per-directory guards pass for all 8 directories: empty, uncommitted, rebar exists returns 1, no open file handles, and mtime >30 minutes old.

Executing rebar tracker-maintenance --clean with equality gate asserted removed all 8 directories, reducing fsck findings from 16 to 7 (MISSING_CREATE and FOREIGN_STORE_PATH counts both zero), with tracker HEAD and git status unchanged.
No committed ticket data was modified; the removed directories were untracked working-tree residue with no git history.
